comment: Which services each product depends on, and what a reader sees if one is down (D-24710). Rendered on the ewiki as the Service Dependency Map (wiki/service-dependency-map.md) by the service-impact shortcode. A product is a site (domainUrl copied exactly from docs/ops/domains.json, which supplies its URL and host) or a job (url/host given here). List each product's dependencies in the order to check them: edge first, then host, then what it calls. impact is one of: down, degraded, stale, deploys, unmonitored. The ewiki build fails on an unknown service id, an impact outside that set, a missing effect, or a live serving domain in domains.json with no product here.

services.name: Cloudflare DNS + proxy
services.check: Run `pnpm check:domains`. If every hostname fails at once, it is Cloudflare, not one app.

services.name: Cloudflare Access
services.check: Only the gated sites use it. `pnpm check:domains` expects a 302/401/403 login redirect for ewiki and dashboard; a 200 means the gate is off.

services.name: Cloudflare Pages
services.check: Pages dashboard → the project → latest production deployment is green and the custom domain is attached.

services.name: Cloudflare Workers
services.check: Workers dashboard → `legendary-arena-wiki` / `legendary-arena-dashboard`, and the last `wiki-viewer` / `dashboard-deploy` run.

services.name: Cloudflare R2 (images.)
services.check: `curl -sI https://images.legendary-arena.com/metadata/sets.json` returns 200. Card data, images, audio, legends snapshots and the database backups all live in R2.

services.name: DigitalOcean droplet (api.)
services.check: UptimeRobot and healthchecks.io `la-droplet-monitor` alert first; `curl https://api.legendary-arena.com/health/db` checks the server and database together. Then SSH in: `systemctl status la-server`, `journalctl -u la-server`.

services.name: PostgreSQL (on the droplet)
services.check: `/health/db` runs `SELECT 1` and answers 503 when the database is down or slow; `la-droplet-monitor` alerts on it. (`/health` does not query the database and stays 200.) On the droplet: `systemctl status postgresql`, `journalctl -u postgresql`.

services.name: Hanko (sign-in)
services.check: Sign in at play.legendary-arena.com; the login page says sign-in is unavailable.

services.name: Stripe (payments)
services.check: Stripe dashboard → Developers → Events and webhook deliveries.

services.name: Snipcart (www shop cart)
services.check: Add an item to the cart on www `/shop/`.

services.name: Brevo (email)
services.check: Brevo dashboard → transactional logs. The server logs and swallows Brevo errors, so nothing fails loudly.

services.name: Anthropic API (AI coach)
services.check: Open a finished match's coach report; a new one returns `coach_unavailable`.

services.name: GitHub (repo, Actions, API)
services.check: `gh run list` for failed or queued runs. Fallbacks while it is down: a local `wrangler deploy` for the ewiki and dashboard (`DOMAINS.md` §Manual deploy fallback) and `40-app-deploy.ps1` on the droplet.

services.name: npm registry
services.check: Build logs fail at `pnpm install` / `npm ci` / `pnpm dlx wrangler`.

services.name: pCloud
services.check: healthchecks.io `la-droplet-pcloud`, then the mirror step in `journalctl -u la-backup`. pCloud has no public status page.

services.name: YouTube
services.check: Open a www blog post with an embedded video.
